newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close slightly higher.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed slightly higher on Wednesday on buying by local and foreign investors, while turnover was helped by domestic buying of plantation shares, brokers said.
The all share index closed 1.25 points higher at 591.22. Aitken Spence rose 5.25 rupees to 95, Hatton National Bank three to 235 and Lanka Orix Leasing three to 145.25
"There were a few instances where foreign investors completed old orders and squared positions for 1996," said Rohan Fernando, a broker at CT Smith.
"Apart from transactions designed to dress up balance sheets, I do not see much happening until early January."
Turnover was 49.1 million rupees on two million shares. The main trade was local buying of 1.7 million shares of Horana Plantations at 24 rupees.
